From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@fastretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick architecture compatibility check before demo

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after my self-serve sign-up. We're interested in a short technical check (15 minutes) before we book a full product demo — just want to confirm a few compatibility points so the broader team doesn't get pulled into a session that isn't relevant yet.

Key things we'd like to confirm in 15 minutes:
- Can Redwood run in a VPC-connected private control plane with outbound-only egress?
- Any requirements for persistent KV cache sizing for a 1B-token weekly workload?
- Do you support on-prem inference (air-gapped) roadmaps / timelines?

We're a small infra team; a focused 15-min triage would be ideal. Our timezone is PST. Do you have availability today?

I can attach a short network diagram if that helps.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Lead ML Engineer
FastRetail
sam.turner@fastretail.com

---
Note: I'll attach a one-page network diagram after this message (pdf).

I've attached a short diagram that shows our current VPC topology and a note on egress restrictions. The file: fastretail-network-diagram.pdf (pdf, 180KB).

A couple of quick notes for prep so the call can be tight:
- We currently route all outbound control-plane traffic through a NAT gateway and only allow specific destinations; we need to understand whether Redwood requires inbound connections for any callbacks.
- The 1B-token weekly workload is spread across multiple tenants; follow-up questions on multi-tenant caching behaviour would be helpful to know if possible in 15 minutes.

If something comes up on your side and you need to nudge to a different 15-min slot, no problem — just let me know.

Sam
